summary_1line: Drona blocks the Pandava assault with the Chakravyuha, forcing Yudhishthira to ask Abhimanyu—who knows only how to enter it—to break the formation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Abhimanyu stands in his chariot before the vast circular Chakravyuha while Yudhishthira and the Pandava warriors urge him to break the formation.
Drona, blazing like the rising sun, halts the charging Pandava heroes with a dense storm of arrows.
Ten thousand red-clad Kaurava warriors with golden standards surge forward under Lakshmana toward Abhimanyu.
